# 5GOOS — Global Observability & Operations Software Solutions (GOOSS)

> Global Observability & Operations Software Solutions (GOOSS) for Modern Infrastructure.
> In 5GOOS, the '5' represents Solutions (5 ⇄ S), paired with GOOS to form GOOSS (Global Observability & Operations Software Solutions).

## Organization Overview
- **Name:** 5GOOS (Global Observability & Operations Software Solutions — GOOSS)
- **Website:** https://5goos.com
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/5goos
- **Primary Contact:** 5goos@proton.me
- **Target Audience:** Cloud engineers, developers, and platform teams working with AWS.

## Core Mission & Approach
5GOOS builds focused open-source web tools and utilities for modern cloud and infrastructure workflows without bloated interfaces, email gates, or telemetry tracking.

## Flagship Open-Source Project: BotoView

- **Live Web Application:** https://botoview.5goos.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/5goos/botoview
- **Category:** Cloud Tooling / AWS SDK
- **Description:** The modern, lightning-fast AWS Boto3 & Botocore changelog explorer, release tracker, and service timeline. An interactive web application to track, filter, and explore AWS Boto3 changelogs, new AWS service additions, and API modifications.
- **Licensing:** Open Source
